name: Spaceship 9d091ca3 on 4.8.8
description: A period-2 spaceship on the truncated square tiling 4.8.8 (touching neighbours), 5 to 9 cells, moving one lattice step every 2 generations (c/2). It runs the same way in the 512 rules from B2/S3 to B25678/S034678; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 270 times). Flagged to check before claiming: runs in B2/S34, the rule of the 4.8.8 hunts (Hexagonal Life without its H). We found no earlier report, but others may well have seen it, so it is not claimed.
